note: The Obscura release bin/vh web install takes: GitHub's release assets of h4ckf0r0day/obscura (Apache-2.0), the build with rendering (screenshots) and without stealth. size and sha256 are what GitHub lists for each asset; Linux x86_64's hash was also measured on the file. Changing the release: the tag, then every size and sha256 from gh api repos/h4ckf0r0day/obscura/releases/tags/<tag> --jq '.assets[]|[.name,.size,.digest]|@tsv', and modules.json's tested. An asset with no sha256 here installs only on --accept-unpinned.
